candidates.name: National Polygon dataset - Technical specification
verified_facts: The National Polygon Dataset publishes HMLR Index Polygons for England and Wales.
Index polygons are an index showing the indicative location of a registered title; title plans/registers govern the general position of title boundaries unless an exact boundary is determined.
HMLR index polygon data is captured to British National Grid.
semantic_limits: An index polygon is not an exact legal-boundary determination and must not be promoted as one.

candidates.publisher: Environment Agency / Defra Data Services Platform
candidates.name: Persistent WCS elevation service update contract
verified_facts: WCS provides raw pixel data such as elevation for LIDAR Composite elevation models.
The year suffix was removed from updated LIDAR Composite endpoints so the endpoint remains persistent for future updates.
The documented 1m DTM WCS endpoint uses OGC WCS 2.0.1.
semantic_limits: A persistent endpoint does not by itself prove that two downloads contain identical raster bytes; byte-level hashes and survey lineage remain required for reproducibility.
